decisions.title: Production promotion is blocked pending a repository licence declaration
decisions.decision: No capability may be promoted to production until the repository declares a licence and the user explicitly approves production promotion.
decisions.reason: The repository contains no LICENSE or COPYING file, so the applicable licence is UNRESOLVED. The P4 gate treats an unknown licence as a hard block. P3 recorded KNOWN_PERMISSIVE on the assumption that project-authored source implies a permissive licence; that assumption was unverified and P4 corrected it to UNDECLARED.
evidence: git ls-files shows no LICENCE or COPYING file

alternatives.rejected_because: An unlicensed repository is all-rights-reserved by default, not permissive.

alternatives.option: Add a LICENSE file on the agent's own initiative
alternatives.rejected_because: Choosing a licence is a legal and ownership decision reserved to the user.

approval.scope: P4 only: phase completion and verification. This approval does NOT authorise production promotion of any capability, does NOT resolve the licence question, and does NOT approve or begin P5.

decisions.title: The SEO CLS verifier is deferred, not promoted

decisions.reason: The CLS threshold fact is verified from SRC-017, but a verified fact is not an implemented capability. Its provenance pointed at a Markdown research file, not code. Gate F and gate K both fail.

alternatives.option: Promote it because the thresholds are verified
alternatives.rejected_because: Verification of a fact is not verification of a capability.

decisions.title: The repository licence remains unresolved and was not chosen
decisions.decision: No licence was selected, added or inferred. The repository licence is recorded as UNRESOLVED and gate D continues to block every production promotion until the User makes an explicit licence decision.

alternatives.rejected_because: The user explicitly prohibited assuming a licence. An unlicensed repository is all-rights-reserved by default.

alternatives.option: Add a LICENSE file to unblock gate D
alternatives.rejected_because: Choosing a licence is a legal decision reserved to the user and was explicitly withheld.
